panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Comic book cover, heroic low-angle shot inside {{vault}}. Exactly three kids stand shoulder to shoulder at the bottom, looking up with determined smiles, left to right: {{maya}}; {{theo}}; {{zara}}. Above their heads floats {{vex}}, glowing. Behind them towers a huge round brass combination lock set in the stone wall, with three smooth blank gold dials in a row. The top quarter is plain dark stone, empty.
panels.alt: Keiko, Andre and Layla stand together at the bottom of a tall stone vault lit by brass lanterns, smiling up at a huge round brass combination lock with three gold dials, while VEX, the small teal robot with one golden eye, floats above them.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Panel inside {{vault}}. {{ring}} at the top center, jammed, a puff of dust and sparks bursting from one of its notches. Below the dial hangs a wide blank dark brass plaque with an empty surface. {{zara}} stands at the lower left with her hands on her head, startled. {{theo}} stands at the lower right, calm, arms crossed.
panels.alt: The great dial is jammed: sparks spit from beside its hub. A dark brass plaque hangs beneath it. Layla throws her hands up on the left while Andre stands calmly with his arms crossed on the right.
